newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour lead Conservatives by 18 points - poll.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour lead Conservatives by 18 points - poll.

text.p: The Labour Party's lead over the ruling Conservative slipped to 18 points, down one, to 49 percent, a Gallup poll for Britain's ITN Channel 4 News showed on Tuesday.
The ruling Conservatives were steady at 31 percent and the minority Liberal Democrats gained one point to 14 percent.
"But when those people who appear 'wobbly' are stripped away, only 49 percent of voters can be safely regarded as solid supporters of their chosen party," ITN said in a statement.
"And among these core voters Labour enjoys a less impressive lead of 10 points (Labour 37, Conservative 27, Liberal Democrat 5.)."

It said the method used to calculate the number of people who are not solid supporters of their chosen party is based on subtracting those people who admit they are uncertain they will vote, those who may change their minds and those who report never in recent memory having actuallly voted for their chosen party.
Gallup interviewed 1466 voters between April 25-28 for the survey, which it said has a margin of error of plus or minus three percent.
